selection: FT and ER separately maximize equal-domain mean on A+B official val after Fog, tie by fewer steps then smaller lr. Lock selected lr/checkpoint for C,D,E. Joint maximizes A-E official val mean, same tie rule.
schedule: Each lr follows one polynomial trajectory to the largest checkpoint. Earlier checkpoints are selectable training budgets on that trajectory.
data_protocol: Entire official train is eligible. Epoch permutations cover each current-domain image. Official val selects hyperparameters. Official test reserved for final website evaluation. No train holdout.
source_stage: Reuse full official Cityscapes-trained checkpoint. No new source training.
